# @ndigo/ui-web

Browser theme adapter for Ndigo UI — apply negotiated themes, persist the user's choice, and keep the DOM and context in sync

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `setVisualTheme` — Resolves, applies, and persists a theme in one call.
- `SetVisualThemeOptions` *(type)* — Options for setVisualTheme.
- `ThemeContextLike` *(type)* — Structural shape of the theme state `setVisualTheme` updates.
- `connectBrowserTheme` — Wires cookie-backed theme resolution into the browser app and applies the current theme.
- `BrowserThemeConnection` *(type)* — Handle returned by connectBrowserTheme.
- `ConnectBrowserThemeOptions` *(type)* — Options for connectBrowserTheme.
